note: AUTHORED, NOT YET CODEQL-VALIDATED. getName()'s PUSH_CONSTANT/PUSH_CONSTANT16 cases index pool[] (set by decompileCONSTANTPOOL from sact->ConstantPool, an attacker-controlled SWF ConstantPool action) using act->p.Constant8 / act->p.Constant16 -- operand fields parsed directly from the untrusted SWF ACTIONPUSH bytecode -- with no check against how many entries the current pool actually holds. pool is reassigned wholesale on every ConstantPool action without freeing/tracking the previous action's allocation lifetime, so an index beyond the current pool's populated range can read a stale pointer left over from an earlier, already-freed pool entry -- a use-after-free (CWE-416): pool[act->p.Constant8/Constant16] dereferences memory that may already have been freed and reused when a prior, smaller ConstantPool action's allocation was replaced. getName() is reached from decompileDELETE via getName(pop()) (decompile.c:3038) as well as from many other decompile*() callers that decompile a popped ActionScript value's name.
